summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. (REIT) filed an 8-K to report entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire a 16,100-sf automotive service property in Overland Park, Kansas for $5.8 million total consideration. The deal requires a $150,000 earnest money deposit. Closing is expected within 45 days subject to customary conditions. The company plans to assign its interest to a newly-formed Delaware statutory trust (DST) and offer beneficial interests to accredited investors via Regulation D private placement, using proceeds to redeem its own interests. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for completion of DST fundraising and regulatory conditions for the private placement; risk-arb angle hinges on investor demand.
